_comment: Two kinds of sources. 'feeds' are curated editorial RSS feeds (full or near-full text). 'topics' are turned into Google News RSS search queries automatically so you don't have to hand-create Google Alerts. Edit freely. Set 'enabled' false to mute a source without deleting it. Optional 'lookbackHours' on a feed widens its freshness window (for blogs that post date-only timestamps or publish weekly).
